item.text:
We need to implement the Workboard app with Node.js, using http and sqlite. Provide UI HTML/JS. Should have routes: GET / health, GET / (list), POST /projects (create), GET /projects/:id (view). Since using built-in http, we need to parse requests manually. Use SQLite via node:sqlite (which is experimental but we can use). We need to store projects table with id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT) and name (TEXT). Use DB_PATH env var.

Implement static files: serve index.html, project.html, maybe JS. Simpler: embed HTML in server responses. Provide client-side JS to fetch and render.

Need data-testid="project-row" for each row.

Also need alert visible with message.

Implement navigation using location.href.

Implement server start with npm start, so package.json scripts: "start": "node server.js". Need to set dependencies? No external dependencies, but node:sqlite is built-in module; we just import it.

We need to commit changes and output commit ID. We have git repo. We'll check status.

We need to provide justification field? The tool signature: justification is required for require_escalated; default is use_default. We are not using require_escalated, so we can omit justification. Let's just call exec_command with cmd and default.
Repository only has package.json currently. Let's view package.json.
